idea: A platform that connects students with private tutors

target_customers: High-school students preparing for matriculation exams (bagrut)
pain_points: Finding an available tutor the same week takes days of messaging
Prices are unclear until after the first call
Needs an app with AI matching
No way to know if a tutor is good before paying

competitors.name: Superprof
competitors.positioning: Global marketplace of private tutors, profiles with hourly rates
competitors.weakness: Hard to filter by course or exam date

market_signals: The Israeli private tutoring market is worth exactly $2.4B and grows 18% a year
Exam periods create demand spikes in January-February and June-July

product_spec.one_liner: Book a vetted tutor for this week's exam in two minutes

personas.name: Noa, 2nd-year economics student
personas.main_pain: Finding an available tutor the same week takes days of messaging
personas.quote: My exam is on Sunday and nobody answers before Thursday.

personas.name: Omer, 11th grade
personas.main_pain: Parents decide and pay, so he cannot choose the tutor he likes
personas.quote: My mom picks the tutor, not me.
